INVALID_ARGUMENT.description: The notification payload failed validation; stable notification wire message: Invalid notification request. Retryable: false.

EXPIRED.description: The notification expires_at timestamp has elapsed; stable notification wire message: Notification has expired. Retryable: false.

AUTH_REQUIRED.description: The WebSocket session is not authenticated for notification delivery; stable notification wire message: Notification delivery requires an authenticated device session.

STORAGE_FULL.description: The approved notification storage quota has no reclaimable capacity; wire message: Notification storage is full. Retry only after capacity is restored, using the same notification_id.

STORAGE_ERROR.description: Notification storage commit or readback failed or is uncertain; wire message: Notification storage operation failed. Keep delivery unknown and retry the same notification_id.

NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_FAILED.description: Notification delivery failed or the A1 return status cannot be classified; wire message: Notification delivery failed. Fail closed and retry only with the same notification_id.

UNAUTHORIZED.description: The client identity or token lacks permissions for the requested operation or entity.

UNKNOWN_OPERATION.description: The requested operation is not registered or supported by any active domain handler.

RESOURCE_BUSY.description: The targeted hardware subsystem or lease is held by another higher/equal-priority owner.

RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.description: The specified entity_id, task_id, reminder_id, or approval_id does not exist.

STATE_CONFLICT.description: The referenced resource or occurrence exists, but its current lifecycle state does not allow the requested transition. Do not retry unchanged; query current state and issue a new request only after the state or user intent changes.

OPERATION_TIMEOUT.description: Execution exceeded allocated deadline without receiving confirmation.

HARDWARE_FAULT.description: Hardware driver or peripheral reported a stall, bus error, or limit violation.

UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE.description: Upstream service (HA Core, Tuya Cloud, or Codex app-server) is disconnected or unreachable.

STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.description: A1 returned the dedicated DESK_NOTIFICATION_ERR_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE (-100), confirming the durable notification provider is unavailable. Stable wire message: Notification storage provider is unavailable. Retry the same notification_id when the provider becomes available.

STATE_UNCONFIRMED.description: The command was accepted upstream, but physical state verification failed or timed out.

APPROVAL_REJECTED.description: The explicit human approval for this turn or item was rejected.

TASK_INTERRUPTED.description: The task was explicitly cancelled or interrupted by user command.

DUPLICATE_REQUEST.description: Request with identical request_id was previously received. Returning cached result.
